headline: CareDx beat Q3 revenue by 16% and raised full-year revenue 7% above consensus and EBITDA by a third
reasoning: Source: CareDx's Q3 2026 release (summarized by MarketScreener; Benzinga 18:02 ET) and Benzinga Newsdesk at 16:02-16:45 ET: 'Q3 Adj. EPS $0.70 Beats $0.25 Estimate, Sales $139.362M Beat $120.608M Estimate'. 'Raises FY26 Rev Guidance To $520M-$530M Prior $490M-$500M; Raises Adj. EBITDA Guidance To $90M-$100M Prior $66M-$78M'; consensus revenue '$489.692M'. The release cites 'a 51% year-over-year increase in testing volume and an adjusted EBITDA margin of 22%'.

What changed: the full-year revenue midpoint rises $30M (to $525M), more than the Q3 beat of about $19M, so Q4 is guided up too. Full-year adjusted EBITDA rises 32% at the midpoint ($72M to $95M). Testing volume +51% y/y is a volume story, not pricing.

Timing: after the close; no regular session has traded it. After-hours IEX prints: 79.04 (16:19 ET, 5 shares), 81.04-81.29 (16:29, 100 shares), 81.64-82.30 (16:36). That is +15% from the 71.48 close, on odd lots only.
Into the print: the stock was flat, 69.11 (10/20) to 71.48, on normal volume (110,677 on 10/29 vs a 75,035 median). No run-up.
objections: The after-hours price rests on about 160 shares of odd-lot prints; the real open is uncertain.
